title: a shorthand field with neither a type nor an initializer is rejected
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule: a has field without an initializer must declare its type (#967). It is static, so the program is rejected before it runs.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: #967 (owner decision 2026-11-22): a field's type is inferred from its initializer; with no initializer an explicit type stays mandatory, and shorthand applies the normal field rules.
